SALUDO KAMI SA INYO! 

Sa gitna ng malakas na ulan at biglaang pagragasa ng baha, nagsilbing bayani ang mga crew ng isang fast food chain sa Visayas Avenue, Barangay Vasra, Quezon City nitong Sabado.

Ayon sa uploader na si Khristine Cerbito Callueng, pumasok ang tubig-baha sa loob ng establisyimento. 

Upang matiyak ang kaligtasan ng kanilang mga customer, agad na nagkabit ng lubid ang mga crew sa isang poste mula sa loob ng store upang gamitin ng mga customer bilang gabay at hawakan upang hindi matangay ng malakas na agos ng tubig.

Sa kabila ng takot dulot ng rumaragasang baha, ligtas na nailikas ang mga tao sa tulong ng mabilis na aksyon ng mga crew. | DZRH News

data.text:
The flash floods in Quezon City today reminded me of the Drainage Master Plan that the city through the leadership of Mayor Joy Belmonte had crafted with the University of the Philippines - Resilience Institute to address the perennial problem of flooding or baha.

It's a beautiful plan with the plan containing 3 Volumes and detailed technical studies, analysis, and reports about flooding in the city and proposed solutions, which includes but is not limited to:

1. Water retention ponds
2. Increasing pipe/culvert capacity
3. Waste reduction in channels through netting
4. Channel dredging
5. Detention/impoundment basins
6. Rain harvest systems

The cost of this comprehensive master plan?

27 Billion Pesos.

Compare this cost to the massive 254 projects of the DPWH worth 14 Billion Pesos (for the period 2021-2025) for Quezon City but with nothing to show for it and such projects were not based on or did not apply the principles behind the comprehensive master plan.

As a victim of Ondoy in 2009, I take the corruption of flood control projects personally.

DPWH should just follow Quezon City's master plan and all District Engineers, Regional Directors, contractors, and Congressmen/Senators involved in flood control projects should lay their hands off of it.

And this obviously goes the same to all cities and provinces in the country with a flood control master plan like Pasig City and Marikina City such as the Pasig-Marikina River Basin Flood Control Master Plan pushed for by Mayor Vico Sotto and Mayor Marcy/Maan Teodoro.

Madami na nga ibang blessings na binabaha sa mga Congressmen and Senators, pati ba naman flood control sasawsaw kayo!

#CorruptionControl
#FloodControl
#JoyBelmonte
#VicoSotto
